summary: Zhihu Inc. filed a Form 6-K with Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Returns, reporting ongoing share repurchases for cancellation. The filing lists 19 daily buyback transactions between July 1-28, 2026, with prices ranging from USD 1.0416 to 1.0944 per share, totaling approximately 2.2 million shares (about 0.8% of outstanding). The daily volumes ranged from 77,673 to 135,000 shares. No board recommendation is mentioned; the repurchases appear part of a standing buyback authorization. The company is executing a capital return program to enhance shareholder value, given the stock trades around USD 1.05. What to watch: the pace of continued repurchases and whether the program accelerates or exhausts its authorization.
